spec.title: Symmetric Tree
taskFacts: Return whether a binary tree mirrors itself about its root.
Corresponding nodes on opposite sides must have equal values and mirrored left/right child structure. Solving both recursively and iteratively is an optional follow-up.

examples.explanation: The two outer grandchildren match and the inner child positions are both absent.
Matching values occupy the same side, rather than mirrored positions.

easier.title: Same Tree
easier.reason: Practice matching the shape and values of two trees
